description: This Java class defines the strategy for handling the 'SudoRetrievePolicyRevision' command in a policy persistence service, specifically when no valid authorization context is provided. It extends an abstract command strategy and implements logic to retrieve a policy revision or throw an exception if inaccessible.

classes.name: SudoRetrievePolicyRevisionStrategy
classes.description: Final class implementing a strategy for handling 'SudoRetrievePolicyRevision' commands, extending abstract query command strategy, with logic to retrieve or reject policy revisions without valid authorization.

methods.name: SudoRetrievePolicyRevisionStrategy
methods.description: Constructor initializing the strategy with the command class.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Core method executing the command logic: retrieves policy revision, constructs response, or throws exception if policy is inaccessible.
